headlines.title: American tourists among hundreds missing after deadly floods in Nepal
headlines.description: Officials in Nepal say hundreds of tourists, including some Americans, are missing after deadly flash floods devastated a region along the country’s border with China. NBC News’ Janis Mackey Frayer reports.

headlines.title: Judge sets 2028 trial for alleged 9/11 mastermind
headlines.description: A military judge has set a June 2028 trial date for Khalid Sheikh Mohammed, the man accused of plotting the September 11 terrorist attacks. NBC News' Kelly O'Donnell reports.

headlines.title: Dolly: An NBC News Special
headlines.description: An in-depth look at the life and legacy of superstar Dolly Parton.

headlines.title: A near-total lunar eclipse will be visible across the U.S. Thursday night
headlines.description: Two weeks after a total solar eclipse wowed skywatchers in Europe, a near-total lunar eclipse is in store Thursday for people in North and South America.

headlines.title: Everything to know about your favorite team this NFL season
headlines.description: NFL Kickoff Guide, powered by NBC Sports breaks down the most important stats, storylines and changes to know for all 32 teams heading into the 2026 season.

headlines.title: Father pushes for change after Meta's $18 billion settlement
headlines.description: Meta has agreed to an $18 billion settlement in a major child safety case tied to claims that social media platforms can harm young users. John Demay, whose son Jordan died after an online sextortion scheme, speaks with NBC News' Tom Llamas about his fight to make social media safer for children and families.

headlines.title: Panda Express’ CEOs are on a ‘mission’ to help workers achieve the dream of home ownership
headlines.description: Panda Express founders Andrew and Peggy Cherng want to be known for helping their workers build careers and eventually buy their own homes.

headlines.title: Witness video of Madison police killing raises questions of why lethal force was used
headlines.description: Local authorities said that the matter is being investigated and that the officers involved have been placed on administrative leave.

headlines.title: Secret Service officials placed on leave in inquiry over ‘potential misconduct’
headlines.description: Secret Service communications director Anthony Guglielmi has been placed on leave, two sources familiar with the matter told NBC News on Wednesday.

headlines.title: Gary, Indiana, nears full power restoration more than 2 weeks after violent storms
headlines.description: A powerful derecho struck northern Indiana and other parts of the Midwest on Aug. 11, knocking out power to tens of thousands.

headlines.title: PGA Tour CEO blasts ‘concerning’ ad depicting a man shoving a female golfer
headlines.description: Good Good Golf took down the ad, saying it “depicted actions that are not aligned with our values as a brand.” PGA Tour CEO Brian Rolapp called the brand’s response “disappointing.”
